tasks.prompt: Following the project's AGENTS.md, create a frontend-only portfolio foundation using Three.js, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Do not add a backend or database. Set up the required scripts and a clear, maintainable source structure, and render a minimal working Three.js scene in the browser. Keep the project compiling so the laboratory portfolio can be built in the next tasks.

Build the portfolio's futuristic laboratory environment on the existing Three.js and TypeScript foundation. Create a readable, atmospheric lab scene with a prominent brain tank area, a computer station, and wild plants growing throughout the room. Use Tailwind for the surrounding interface and make the layout adapt to smaller screens. Keep the experience entirely frontend-only and ensure the project builds.

Implement the central containment tank and its brain centerpiece in the existing laboratory scene. Give the tank a futuristic glass, fluid, and lighting treatment, and add subtle animation to the brain and surrounding effects so the scene feels alive without distracting from the portfolio. Keep rendering performant and clean up Three.js resources appropriately. Ensure the project builds.

Make the lab computer the portfolio's navigation interface. Add exactly four clearly labeled controls for Biography, Personal Projects, Technical Skills, and Certifications. Make each control usable with a pointer and keyboard, and connect it to the appropriate content popup that will be implemented next. Preserve the established visual style and ensure the project builds.

Implement an accessible popup for each of the four portfolio sections: Biography, Personal Projects, Technical Skills, and Certifications. The popup content should be intentionally empty or contain a clear placeholder that is easy for the owner to replace with their own information later. Include a visible close control, close on Escape, and sensible focus handling. Ensure the project builds.

Add a compact set of no more than four controls for visually changing the containment tank. Choose useful parameters such as fluid level, glow intensity, brain pulse speed, or tank color, and make each control visibly affect the Three.js scene immediately. Keep the controls intuitive and styled as part of the lab interface. Ensure the project builds.

Polish and complete the laboratory portfolio. Add a language toggle in the top-right corner, default to English, and allow switching the full interface between English and French, including navigation labels, popups, and control labels. Review the responsive layout, keyboard access, visible focus states, readable contrast, and Three.js behavior on smaller screens. Keep the app frontend-only, preserve exactly four portfolio sections and at most four tank controls, and ensure the project builds without errors.
